theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RA : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), RA.Represents A → ∃ (Av : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Rv : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Rv.Represents Av ∧ (∀ φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, currentEval Av φ = currentEval A (fun y => φ (y + v))) ∧ ∀ C : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → Rv.measure C = RA.measure ((fun y => y + v) ⁻¹' C)
